claim_scope: Administrative availability inventory only; no measured service or adaptation cost, independent verifier benefit or ARC level solve. Does not close GAP-ORACLE-DISTINCT or GAP-DETECTOR-AUROC-4208.

inference_substrate_details.scope: pre-load inventory only; no service timings

exposure_scope: Original LPHB exposed human development panel. Fixtures are mechanics only; exact-oracle gains would be circular_positive.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The mandated model cannot be silently replaced.
field_principles.adaptation_cost_ready_score: Sparse updates cannot replace full guards, durable commits and actual recovery.
field_principles.amdahl_ceiling_or_null: Amdahl ceilings require measured component fractions.
field_principles.branch_eligibility: Missing learning trajectories cannot independently block qualified static service.
field_principles.clock_boundary_map: Only matching nonoverlapping measured clocks support fractions.
field_principles.cold_load_rows: Fresh process load time stays separate from warm request latency.
field_principles.complete_adaptation_rows: Rejected proposals, failed work, final drain and recovery all have a cost.
field_principles.cost_inventory_ready_score: Complete accounting does not establish service performance.
field_principles.current_work_receipts: Only owned current events count as executed model work.
field_principles.energy_joules_or_null: Joules require power integrals, never vendor TDP.
field_principles.failed_censored_work: Unavailable or failed work cannot vanish from the denominator.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact operands distinguish missing files, missing fields and observed zero.
field_principles.hardware_operation_rows: Future operation mapping is separate from measured board performance.
field_principles.independent_generalization_score: Exposed development cannot establish independent human generalization.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: A pre-load refusal is blocked_no_run and owes no padded duration.
field_principles.model_invocation_counts: Attempted forward work is not generated tokens or historical inference.
field_principles.paired_service_cost_rows: Outer clocks must include tokenization, forward, all eligible heads and serialization.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: All published observations, including failed gates, are bound together.
field_principles.requested_inference_substrate_class: Intended work stays distinct from executed work.
field_principles.rows: Unstarted scientific work remains visible beside completed administrative checks.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Siblings and repeated processes do not create independent questions.
field_principles.scientific_parity_rows: A faster path must preserve probabilities within frozen tolerance and identical decisions.
field_principles.service_cost_ready_score: Readiness requires complete matched outer clocks and scientific parity.
field_principles.source_references: Retained immutable bytes preserve historical producer authority.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Readiness requires real child exits and byte-bound checker logs.

hardware_operation_rows.prerequisite: Complete paired service clocks and correctness, including recovery; no acquisition required.
Authenticated lease/runtime and exact Qwen embedding receipt; matched batching, precision, startup, transfers and service costs before continued lease or purchase.
A supported equivalent kernel, fixed-point parity and matched actual-device complete service costs; deterministic spline locality alone is insufficient.
Exact hash-bound current CPU workload and complete costs; fabric acceleration requires a separate authenticated kernel and parity receipt.
Operator-dated cable, port or power change, then valid GM1Ax IDCODE and ordered n16 smoke; no unchanged bring-up scheduled.
Working supported SDK, equivalent operators, precision parity and actual-device complete service evidence.
Authenticated device/SDK access, supported stochastic lowering, sample quality and whole-service evidence including host and transfers; vendor energy claims are insufficient.
Measured current compatible bottleneck, capacity need and matched actual-device service benefit before procurement.

hardware_scope.CPU: tokenization, transformations, heads, full CAL, serialization, fsync and recovery
hardware_scope.GPU: frozen forward/reduction; GPU0 lease and actual CUDA offload required

methodology_note: Freeze exact upstream fields and producer bytes before model work. Retain first20 original TEST groups/all60 siblings, three fresh processes, seed776108 and parity tolerances. Static and online gates are independent. Missing scientific inputs terminate before load; inventory time is not latency. No duration padding, fallback, downloads, generation, training, GPU1, board contact, Rust speedup or assumed learning gain.

protocol.energy: raw text/tokenize/all teacher-forced statistics/frozen probability and energy heads/serialize
protocol.formulas: Exp9126 immutable full-vocabulary formulas; no gate or denominator changes
